facts.material: PVC (4 mm base, 0.5 mm backing) with 0.5 mm decorative wood veneer layer

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 3918 floor coverings of plastics in rolls or tiles; PVC is >90% of thickness so plastics give the character; GRI 3(b) essential character would also favor PVC over the thin veneer
GRI 6: 3918.10.10 of polymers of vinyl chloride, vinyl tile; 4 mm rigid PVC base taken as rigid solid polymer core (.20)

rejected_alternatives.reason: plywood/veneered wood panels; wood veneer is only 0.5 of 5 mm so wood is not the essential character
assembled flooring panels of wood/bamboo; PVC predominates
other vinyl tile; used for cork-core planks in N327606, applies only if core is not rigid solid polymer

missing_facts: Whether the PVC base is a rigid solid (e.g. stone plastic composite) core or otherwise
classification.rationale: Click-lock PVC planks are vinyl floor coverings of heading 3918; the thin wood veneer is a decorative surface layer only. A 4 mm solid PVC base is treated as a rigid solid polymer core as in N341739 (in force).
